function.name: finish_research
function.arguments: {"observations": "Live Coupang searches for 부적, 팔찌, and 재물운 all returned EMPTY_RESULT (exitCode 66), so nine new detail pages were selected from prior observed Coupang candidates via load_prior_candidates. Selection (3 per keyword): 부적 → 9079193243 (신유당 친필 정법부적, 37600원), 9074211102 (대광법사 친필 수제부적, 3000원), 9747637805 (플리터스 휴대용 부적 카드, 8910원); 팔찌 → 9174439527 (베리엣지 흑요석 오행 팔찌, 25800원), 9661003014 (오브룸 쿠반 체인팔찌, 9900원), 8340398350 (호안석 블루 타이거아이 원석팔찌, 26950원); 재물운 → 8413135628 (서온리 도자기 황금돼지 저금통, 31900원), 8771363815 (만월재 달항아리 소금단지, 23500원), 8003834482 (휘뚜마뚜 마네키네코 세트, 10900원). All nine IDs are distinct and none overlap the ten excluded IDs. collect_details returned status \"complete\" for all nine products this run. Observed detail formats: title (Korean, often with option/variant suffix), selected_options (sometimes null; when present, free-text label:value pairs such as 프레임색상:블랙, 사이즈:5cm x 6.5cm, 색상:삼족두꺼비 세트, 1+1 마네키네코:화이트 & 베이지, or odd seller-entered text like \"출판사\\n12번 바람방지\"), detail_text_excerpt (mostly empty strings or whitespace/newline-only blocks — e.g., 8340398350 had only repeated blank lines), and detail_images counts ranging 1–17 (9079193243:17, 9074211102:1, 9747637805:8, 9174439527:12, 9661003014:6, 8340398350:10, 8413135628:6, 8771363815:14, 8003834482:6). Prior candidate list data format included product_id, rank, Korean title, KRW price, coupang.com/vp/products URL, prior_source job path + sha256, and search_keywords. Seller luck claims (e.g., 금전재물, 행운, 재물운, 영험함) remain unverified marketing text; no purchases, account changes, or messages were made."}
